claims.claim: Nikon D810 DSLR Camera + 24-70mm Lens for Sale
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Nikon DSLR body with a large attached lens, but the exact model number/name (D810) and the lens focal length (24-70mm) are not readable in the provided photo.

claims.claim: Clean and well-maintained Nikon D810 camera
claims.evidence: Witness notes used condition with no obvious cracks visible, but no clear evidence of cleanliness/maintenance level (scratches, dents, sensor/lens glass condition) is provided.
Visible Nikon branding on the camera body in Photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D810 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the front/top/bottom plate) and the lens model/focal length markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Nikon DSLR body with an unspecified lens (worst-case within the shown category), assuming typical used wear and no confirmed premium model.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 24-70mm; could be a different focal length/aperture or a non-matching/low-grade lens.
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the lens nameplate showing focal length range (e.g., 24-70mm) and model number, plus front element clarity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified Nikon-compatible zoom lens with unknown specs.

risks.risk: Functional issues (autofocus, shutter performance, buttons/ports) not verifiable from the single photo.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing autofocus working on a moving subject and a live-view focus check, plus a quick menu/port check (e.g., HDMI/USB/SD slot).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/unknown functionality.

risks.risk: Sensor and lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, haze, dust) not shown clearly.
risks.proof: Photos of the lens glass (front and rear) and a test shot showing dust/sensor spots (e.g., a blank wall at high f-stop).
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible cosmetic/optical wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, caps, hood, strap, manuals/box) affecting usability and resale.
risks.proof: A full accessories layout photo showing battery model, charger, memory card (if any), lens caps/hood, and any included cables/manuals.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items (camera + lens only).

risks.risk: Battery health and shutter count unknown; high shutter count or weak battery reduces value.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera’s battery status and a screen showing shutter count (or equivalent service/metadata screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown battery health and unknown shutter count.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model label/text to confirm it is truly D810.
Clear close-up photo of the lens nameplate showing it is 24-70mm (and the exact lens model).
Video clip: autofocus working (live view + focus on a moving object) and quick demonstration of shutter/button responsiveness.
Photos of lens front and rear glass (no haze/fungus/scratches) and a sensor dust test shot (blank wall at high f-stop).
Photo showing included items: battery, charger, memory card (if any), lens caps/hood, strap, and any manuals/box.
Photo of shutter count and battery status screen/metadata.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR body with a lens, but the critical details that determine the correct model and lens value (D810 and 24-70mm) are not readable, and functionality/accessories are not verifiable from the single photo. Proof is needed before a reliable price can be set.
